SELECT repairOrder.* , customer.customer_name AS customerName , vehicle.plate_number AS plateNumber , sysUser.real_name AS realName , sysUser2.real_name AS realName2 , repairItemCategory.category_name AS categoryName FROM repair_order repairOrder LEFT JOIN customer customer ON repairOrder.customer_id = customer.id LEFT JOIN vehicle vehicle ON repairOrder.vehicle_id = vehicle.id LEFT JOIN sys_user sysUser ON repairOrder.service_user_id = sysUser.id LEFT JOIN sys_user sysUser2 ON repairOrder.engineer_user_id = sysUser2.id LEFT JOIN repair_item_category repairItemCategory ON repairOrder.repair_item_category_id = repairItemCategory.id
ORDER BY repairOrder.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT repairOrder.* , customer.customer_name AS customerName , vehicle.plate_number AS plateNumber , sysUser.real_name AS realName , sysUser2.real_name AS realName2 , repairItemCategory.category_name AS categoryName FROM repair_order repairOrder LEFT JOIN customer customer ON repairOrder.customer_id = customer.id LEFT JOIN vehicle vehicle ON repairOrder.vehicle_id = vehicle.id LEFT JOIN sys_user sysUser ON repairOrder.service_user_id = sysUser.id LEFT JOIN sys_user sysUser2 ON repairOrder.engineer_user_id = sysUser2.id LEFT JOIN repair_item_category repairItemCategory ON repairOrder.repair_item_category_id = repairItemCategory.id WHERE repairOrder.id = #{id}

SELECT su.id FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.engineer_user_id = su.id AND ro.status = 1 WHERE su.role_type = 'engineer' AND su.status = 1 GROUP BY su.id ORDER BY COUNT(ro.id) ASC LIMIT 1
